brief: For Langmere Common 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-331), apply the cooling defect reduction to the permissible load in proportion to the capacity lost, and apply ambient de-rating for average ambient above 30 degrees [MG-021]. Consider emergency load transfer where the unit approaches its temperature limit, confirming the receiving asset's available capacity with MG-021 de-rating and checking its condition before switching [ERP-032]. On events exceeding 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
